title: Projects: create under agent/vault working root (not /Projects generic)
description:
## Clarified product requirement (2026-07-31)
The **agent working directory / vault root** is the only root for projects.

Example:
- Agent WD / vault = `$HOME/lanyard` (mapped as vault `/` or host primary root)
- User creates projects as **subdirectories of that root**, e.g.:
  - `/clients`
  - `/Business`
  - `/Business/relationships`
- **Do not** invent a separate generic namespace like `/Projects/...` as the default create location.

## Current (wrong)
- `portal/packages/web/src/features/projects/projectOptions.ts`
  - `DEFAULT_PROJECTS_ROOT = "/Projects"`
  - `defaultFolderPath(name)` → `/Projects/<Name>`
- New project dialog placeholder `/Projects/Demo` (`ChatHistorySideNav.tsx`)
- Live QA 2026-07-31: path auto-filled `/Projects/QaRootProject`
- Tests encode `/Projects` as required (`projectOptions.test.ts`, `test_lp_swt_ux_wave.py` swt1)

## Desired behavior
1. Default new-project working directory is a **subdir of the agent/vault root**, not under a forced `/Projects` prefix.
   - Prefer vault-relative path like `/<Name>` or `/path/user/typed` under root.
   - If a "current project" is selected, default under that project's path: `{selected.primary_path}/{slug}`.
2. The root project / main route is the agent working directory (vault root). Users cannot (by default UX) create projects outside that root.
3. Nested folders (`clients/business/relationships`) are first-class create targets under the root.
4. BFF/Brain RPC `projects.create` folders[] stay consistent with vault-relative paths under VAULT_ROOT.
5. Update tests that currently require `/Projects/` prefix (lp-swt.1 intent was "vault-relative not ~/" — keep that, drop hard-coded Projects namespace if product rejects it).

## Acceptance
- [ ] New project dialog defaults path under agent/vault root (e.g. `/Acme` or `/clients/Acme`), never forces `/Projects/...` unless operator explicitly types it
- [ ] With selected parent project, default path nests under that project's vault_path/primary_path
- [ ] Creating `Business/relationships` yields a project bound to that cwd under the root
- [ ] Unit + Playwright updated; no test asserts DEFAULT_PROJECTS_ROOT === "/Projects" as product truth
- [ ] Docs/copy: "working directory under agent vault root" not "under /Projects"

## Files
- `portal/packages/web/src/features/projects/projectOptions.ts`
- `ChatHistorySideNav.tsx` (dialog)
- `hermesProjects.ts` / BFF create path
- `projectOptions.test.ts`, `test_lp_swt_ux_wave.py`
- Possibly context API: expose vault root / agent home for defaults

## Priority
Raise to P1 — core Directory UX mismatch with real Company Brain layout.
notes: SHIP: Merged PR #209 https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/209. defaultFolderPath /Name under vault root; unit 22/22; UI QA dialog path /SwtQaVault not /Projects; screenshots artifacts/ui/lp-75r.5/.
close_reason: New project create defaults to /Name under agent vault root (or nested under selected project vault_path); removed forced /Projects prefix. Unit tests 22/22; Playwright swt1 updated. PR #209 draft. commit c09b1fe. needs_ui_qa for live dialog proof.

title: feature: skill detail dialog centered markdown preview only
description:
## Problem
Settings skill detail opens as a docked drawer top-right (`position={{ top: 16, right: 16, bottom: 16 }}`) and shows Name/Enabled/Description/Path + \"Instructions\" chrome. Product wants a **centered** dialog with **only** the skill markdown preview, using the same Markdown renderer used app-wide (`@astryxdesign/core/Markdown`).

## Evidence (code)
- SettingsDetailDrawer.tsx Dialog position top/right/bottom
- SkillDetail MetadataList: Enabled badge, Path, Instructions label
- BodyBlock already uses Markdown for .md paths (good — keep/ensure)

## Goal
1. Dialog centered on the page (remove corner dock position; use default center placement)
2. Skill view: no path, no enabled state, no instructions meta chrome — only rendered skill body (markdown)
3. Header may keep skill name as dialog title (DialogHeader title already uses item.name) — subtitle \"Skill\" optional; prefer minimal
4. Markdown via existing `@astryxdesign/core/Markdown` (same as VaultReader / chat), not a one-off

## Design
1. For skill kind only (or all settings details if simpler without product harm): drop `position={{ top, right, bottom }}` so Dialog centers. User said \"skills page and settings, the skills little window\" — skill is the requirement; workflows/cron can keep richer metadata unless centering is shared (centering shared is fine; do not strip workflow/cron metadata unless cheap).
2. SkillDetail: remove MetadataList (enabled, path, description list). Load body as today; render BodyBlock / Markdown only. Loading spinner ok. Empty states ok.
3. Tests in SettingsView.test.tsx that assert path/enabled text must be updated to assert markdown body + centered dialog testid.

## Files
- portal/packages/web/src/features/settings/SettingsDetailDrawer.tsx
- portal/packages/web/src/features/settings/SettingsView.test.tsx

## Out of scope
Skill enable/disable toggle on the list (only the detail window content).
design:
Data shape: SkillDetail is body-only view model (content + mime/path for markdown detect internally, not displayed).
Laziness: delete metadata UI rather than hide with CSS.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Skill detail Dialog is centered (no top-right dock position prop)
- [ ] Skill detail does not render path, enabled badge, or \"Instructions\" label chrome
- [ ] Skill body renders with `@astryxdesign/core/Markdown` for markdown content
- [ ] SettingsView tests updated and pass
close_reason: Done. PR https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/201 merged. Centered skill markdown dialog; 24 tests green.

title: feature: Office files open OnlyOffice only (no preview/edit chrome)
description:
## Problem
Microsoft/Office files still surface dual-mode UX:
- Vault: Edit / Back to preview buttons + \"Editing in Office — changes save…\" toolbar label (VaultDocumentHost.tsx)
- Chat document pane: Edit document / Back to preview (DocumentPaneShell + resolveChatDocumentRenderer + ChatView editControls)
Product wants: when OnlyOffice can open the file, that is the **only** view — no preview toggle, no edit button, no mode banner/tooltip header for Office.

## Evidence (code)
- chatDocumentRenderer.ts: default preview; OnlyOffice only in edit mode; showEdit/showExitEdit toggles
- artifactPanelReducer open events force preferred edit → preview first
- DocumentPaneShell toolbar Edit / Back to preview
- VaultDocumentHost: auto-edit exists (lp-xcu.2) but still shows toolbar with Back to preview + \"Editing in Office\" text
- isOfficeEditorPath / resolveVaultEditAffordance gate type+flag+vault_edit

## Goal
For Office-eligible files when gates pass (feature flag + ui.can.vault_edit + supported type):
1. Open OnlyOffice immediately (mode edit/session mint) as sole body renderer
2. No Edit button, no Back to preview, no \"Editing in Office\" (or similar) chrome
3. Same behavior in vault main pane and chat sidebar document pane
4. When gates fail: fall back to existing non-Office preview path without showing Office edit chrome (no dead Edit button)

## Design (normative)
1. **Domain model:** for office-eligible + gates: renderer=onlyoffice, officeActive=true, showEdit=false, showExitEdit=false always. Remove dual-mode affordance for this class.
2. VaultDocumentHost: remove edit/preview toolbar block for office success path; keep save-issue/dirty banners if they are functional save status (not \"Editing in Office\" marketing chrome). User asked no tooltip/header saying Editing in Office — remove that Text span and the Edit/Back buttons. If dirty/save banners are still needed for correctness, keep them minimal without mode-toggle chrome.
3. resolveChatDocumentRenderer: when fileSupported && editorEnabled && canVaultEdit → officeActive regardless of panel \"preview\" mode; never showEdit/showExitEdit.
4. artifactPanelReducer / open path: open office files into edit/opening that binds Office session without requiring PANEL_REQUEST_EDIT.
5. DocumentPaneShell: with editControls null for office, toolbar keeps Reload/Vault/Download/Close only (path title ok — user objected to Office mode header specifically).
6. Update tests: chatDocumentRenderer.test, VaultDocumentHost.test, DocumentPaneShell.test, ChatView wiring if covered.

## Files (expected)
- portal/packages/web/src/features/chat/documentPane/chatDocumentRenderer.ts(+test)
- portal/packages/web/src/features/chat/documentPane/artifactPanelReducer.ts(+test) as needed
- portal/packages/web/src/features/chat/documentPane/DocumentPaneShell.tsx(+test)
- portal/packages/web/src/features/chat/ChatView.tsx (editControls wiring)
- portal/packages/web/src/features/vault/VaultDocumentHost.tsx(+test)
- portal/packages/web/src/features/vault/vaultEditGating.ts only if affordance fields need rename (prefer keep showEdit false)

## Out of scope
Non-office markdown/image VaultReader; Document Server config; mint API changes.
design:
Data shape: ChatDocumentRendererDecision drops dual-mode for office-eligible; showEdit/showExitEdit always false when officeActive or when product policy is office-only.
Organizing structure: pure resolveChatDocumentRenderer + VaultDocumentHost open policy; delete previewPreferred dual path if unused.
Shared: one implementer owns vault+chat to keep UX identical.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Opening an Office file (docx/xlsx/pptx/…) with gates on mounts OnlyOffice without user clicking Edit (vault + chat sidebar)
- [ ] No Edit / Back to preview controls rendered for Office when OnlyOffice is active
- [ ] No \"Editing in Office\" (or equivalent mode) header/tooltip chrome on vault or chat Office view
- [ ] When gates fail for Office type, no Edit button; VaultReader/fallback only
- [ ] Unit tests updated and pass for renderer, VaultDocumentHost, DocumentPaneShell
- [ ] Non-Office files unchanged
close_reason: Done. PR https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/200 merged. Office-only open vault+chat; 82 tests green.

- `NewProjectDialog` in ChatHistorySideNav.tsx binds that default
- Contract example uses vault-relative folders: `\"/Projects/Ops\"` (contracts/backend-runtime-v1/examples/brain-rpc.projects-create.request.json)
- Host create: POST /api/agent/projects with `folders` (hermesProjects.createProject)

## Goal
Default (and create) project working directories **under the approved vault root** so create makes a new vault area.

## Design (normative)
1. Replace `~/Projects` default with **vault-relative** root `/Projects` (or equivalent approved projects namespace under vault). Path shape: `/Projects/<NameOrSlug>`.
2. `defaultFolderPath` always produces vault-root-relative paths under that namespace (leading `/`, not `~`).
3. UI field label can stay \"Working directory\"; placeholder/examples use vault-relative form.
4. Prefer not requiring user to type host absolute VAULT_ROOT. Host/Brain RPC already accepts vault-relative folders in the contract example.
5. If BFF currently expands `~` only (resolveFolderPath), ensure vault-relative `/Projects/...` is passed through unchanged to Brain RPC / hermes create (no homedir rewrite of absolute-looking vault paths).
6. Optional: when folders omitted, host may default under vault — but **web must send** the vault-under path so behavior is explicit.
7. Tests: projectOptions unit tests; ChatHistorySideNav create dialog default; hermesProjects/projects client mapping; BFF resolveFolderPath does not corrupt `/Projects/X`.

## Files (expected)
- portal/packages/web/src/features/projects/projectOptions.ts
- portal/packages/web/src/features/projects/projectOptions.test.ts
- portal/packages/web/src/features/projects/ChatHistorySideNav.tsx
- portal/packages/web/src/features/projects/ChatHistorySideNav.test.tsx
- portal/packages/web/src/api/hermesProjects.ts / tests if mapping changes
- portal/packages/bff/src/hermes-projects.ts resolveFolderPath only if needed for pass-through

## Out of scope
Multi-tenant ACL redesign; control-plane /api/projects ACL rows.
design:
Data shape: ProjectCreatePath = vault-root-relative POSIX path under /Projects.
Organizing structure: pure defaultFolderPath helper + dialog state; no new globals.
Architect: n/a single-module path constant change with tests.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] DEFAULT_PROJECTS_ROOT (or successor) is vault-relative under approved projects namespace (e.g. `/Projects`), not `~/Projects`
- [ ] defaultFolderPath(\"Beta\") === `/Projects/Beta` (or approved equivalent); empty name still under that root
- [ ] New Project dialog pre-fills vault-under path; create submits that path as vault_path/folders
- [ ] Unit tests updated and pass (`pnpm --filter @lanyard/web test` covering projectOptions + dialog)
- [ ] If BFF path resolution touched: vault-relative `/Projects/...` not rewritten to homedir
- [ ] Summary notes residual: host must create real dir under VAULT_ROOT (Brain RPC responsibility)

title: epoch: Portal UX fixes — vault project create, Office-only open, skill preview modal
description:
## Why
Three portal UX defects/features block day-to-day vault use: (1) new projects default cwd under ~/Projects instead of the approved vault tree, so creates miss the vault; (2) Microsoft/Office files still expose preview/edit toggle chrome and banners instead of opening OnlyOffice as the sole view (vault main pane + chat document sidebar); (3) settings skill detail drawer docks top-right with path/enabled/instructions noise instead of a centered markdown preview.

## Scope
portal monorepo only (`portal/packages/web`, possibly BFF defaults for projects.create folders). Not Daytona, not lanyard-agent core.

## Product outcomes
1. New project working directory defaults under approved vault root (vault-relative `/Projects/<name>` aligned with contracts example brain-rpc.projects-create; host expands via VAULT_ROOT). Create places a new vault area the user can browse.
2. For Office/Microsoft file types when OnlyOffice gates pass: mount OnlyOffice only — no Edit button, no Back to preview, no "Editing in Office" toolbar/tooltip chrome. Same for chat sidebar document pane.
3. Skills detail dialog: centered on page; content is skill body markdown via app-standard Markdown renderer; no path, enabled badge, or Instructions chrome for skills.

## Playbook
P-stack multi-phase + Feature leaves + beads-execute drain + WebUI QA after merge.

## Decision trail
.audit/portal-ux-wave.tsv

## Non-goals
- Changing non-Office VaultReader behavior
- Reworking workflow/cron detail drawers beyond skill-specific UX (unless shared dialog positioning is one change)
- Host Brain RPC protocol changes beyond folder path defaults
design:
### Throughput checkpoint
**Blocking first steps:** none across the three product leaves — they are package-path disjoint enough to parallelize. Shared design notes live on this epic.

**Independent workstreams:**
1. Project create under vault root — `portal/packages/web/src/features/projects/*` (+ optional BFF path normalize if needed)
2. Office-only open — `portal/packages/web/src/features/vault/VaultDocumentHost*` + `.../chat/documentPane/*` + ChatView wiring
3. Skill preview modal — `portal/packages/web/src/features/settings/SettingsDetailDrawer*`
4. WebUI QA after 1–3 merge

**Shared mutable state:** none across leaves (different files). Office vault+chat share gate helpers; keep one implementer for Office surfaces.

**Smallest safe decomposition:** 3 feature leaves + 1 QA leaf. No mega-PR.

### Principles shaping design
- Experience first: Office opens the only useful view; skill dialog is content-first
- Laziness protocol: delete dual-mode chrome rather than add flags
- Model the domain: open-mode for office-eligible files is onlyoffice|unavailable, not preview↔edit
- Subtract before add: remove Edit/Back/banner before adding new layout
- Boundary discipline: vault root default as vault-relative path at UI/BFF edge; host owns absolute join
- Sequence verifiable units: each leaf ships tests; QA after merge
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] All child leaves closed with evidence
- [ ] Unit tests green for touched packages
- [ ] Merged to main
- [ ] App restarted with merged code
- [ ] WebUI QA bead closed with visual evidence
notes: Children: lp-swt.1 projects | lp-swt.2 office | lp-swt.3 skills | lp-swt.4 qa | lp-swt.5 merge/restart. Decision trail: .audit/portal-ux-wave.tsv
close_reason: Epoch complete: three features merged + WebUI QA green. PRs 199-201 (+ QA PR).

title: settings: detail drawer for skill, workflow, and cron instructions
description:
## Problem
Settings lists skills, workflows, and crons as tables only. Users cannot click into an item to see what the skill does, what the workflow is, or what the cron job runs.

## Root cause
No detail route/drawer. Snapshot intentionally omits full bodies. No on-demand content API wired for settings entities (vault path fetch may exist for files).

## Approach
1. Row click (or View action) opens a detail drawer/panel in SettingsView.
2. Content loading:
   - Skills: fetch SKILL.md (or path) content via existing vault/file API when path is known; show name, enabled, description, markdown body.
   - Workflows: fetch definition file at path (or description + IR summary); show name, path, updated_at, body.
   - Crons: show name, schedule (humanized), enabled, last/next run, command/payload if present in snapshot or jobs detail endpoint.
3. Keep list snapshot light; detail is on-demand.
4. If path missing, show honest empty state ("No file path on host for this item").
5. Markdown render for skill/workflow prose bodies (reuse Markdown component).
6. BFF: add GET detail helpers only if vault/content API is insufficient (prefer reuse).

## Files
- SettingsView.tsx (drawer UI)
- api/settings.ts (optional detail fetch)
- BFF settings routes if needed
- tests SettingsView detail open/render

## Repo
lanyard-platform (+ agent only if new RPC required for cron command body)
Depends on lp-a8u.6 metadata and lp-a8u.7 refresh so detail targets exist.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Click skill row → drawer shows name + instructions/body (markdown) or honest empty
- [ ] Click workflow row → drawer shows definition/description
- [ ] Click cron row → drawer shows schedule + job details available from host
- [ ] Closing drawer returns to list without losing section
- [ ] Unit tests for open/close and content render
- [ ] Live: after create + refresh, open detail for the new item
close_reason: Done. PR https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/198. Settings detail drawer + content APIs + tests.

title: settings: refresh inventory after chat create and on Settings focus
description:
## Problem
When the user creates a skill, workflow, cron job, or similar via chat, Settings still shows the old snapshot until full remount. Users never see what they just created.

## Root cause
SettingsSnapshotProvider auto-loads once on mount. refreshSnapshot() exists but no UI/callers. Chat tool completion does not invalidate settings. No focus/visibility refetch.

## Approach
1. Call refreshSnapshot() when user navigates to Settings (section focus / tab select) — cheap and reliable.
2. Optional manual "Refresh" control in Settings header for power users.
3. On chat tool completion events that likely mutate inventory (skill create/write, workflow write, cron create/update — detect by tool name / portal_event / metadata), debounce-call refreshSnapshot from a shared context bridge (PortalShell or ChatView → SettingsSnapshotContext).
4. Do not require a new SSE channel in this bead (deferred).
5. After refresh, tables re-render from new snapshot; optimistic toggles remain for PATCH.

## Heuristic tool names (confirm against LA builtins)
- skill_manage / skill create family
- workflow create/save
- cron / job schedule tools
Prefer metadata flags if host adds inventory_mutated: true later.

## Files
- SettingsSnapshotContext.tsx
- SettingsView.tsx
- PortalShell.tsx / ChatView.tsx / useChatEvents.ts for invalidation hook
- tests for provider refresh on focus + tool completion

## Repo
lanyard-platform. Best after lp-a8u.6 so workflows appear on refresh.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Opening Settings after mount re-fetches snapshot (or explicit focus of Settings tab does)
- [ ] After agent creates a skill/workflow/cron (or simulated tool_progress completion), Settings list updates without full page reload
- [ ] Debounced: rapid tool events do not stampede snapshot API
- [ ] Manual refresh control if added is accessible and works
- [ ] Unit/integration tests for refresh triggers
- [ ] Live: create via chat → Settings shows new row
close_reason: Done. PR https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/197. Settings focus + debounced inventory refresh.

title: settings: LA snapshot include workflows + list metadata for detail
description:
## Problem
Settings → Workflows is empty on live Lanyard Agent hosts. Snapshot skills/crons are list-only metadata (no description/body for detail drawer). Production expectation: user-created workflows (and enough skill/cron metadata) appear under Settings.

## Root cause
- SETTINGS_INCLUDE_SECTIONS omits "workflows"
- collect.ts has no collectWorkflows (offline BFF settings-discover does walk .lanyard/workflows)
- Skill DTO: id, name, enabled, path only — no description/summary
- Cron DTO: no last/next/command fields aligned with Portal columns

## Approach
1. Add "workflows" to SETTINGS_INCLUDE_SECTIONS.
2. collectWorkflows: walk BACKEND_HOME/.lanyard/workflows (mirror BFF discoverWorkflows); return id, name, path, description?, updated_at?, enabled?.
3. Optionally enrich skills with description from SKILL.md frontmatter name/description (not full body — detail bead fetches content).
4. Enrich crons with schedule, enabled, last_run_at/next_run_at if available from jobs.json.
5. Keep hermes_home as deprecated alias; prefer backend_home.
6. Contract/schema: update brain-rpc settings types if schema in monorepo requires it.

- tests for collect/snapshot

title: workflow nest: host emit stage→subagent_ids on workflow_progress
description:
## Problem
Workflow inline/pop-out stage dropdowns expand and show "No nested activity yet" even when subagents are running. Nested subagent chips and loading spinners never appear under stages.

## Root cause (agent)
Portal UI already resolves nested runs via resolveStageSubagents(stage.subagentIds, roster). Story fixtures work because they hard-code subagentIds.

Live agent path:
- apps/gateway/src/workflow-portal-progress.ts projects stages with projectWorkflowProgressForPortal(state, { plannedPhases }) only — never passes stageSubagentIds / stageToolCallIds.
- packages/workflow/src/portal-progress.ts supports stageSubagentIds maps in tests only.
- Subagent tool_progress dual-emits exist (portal-telemetry + inbound-pipeline) but are not linked into workflow stage snapshots.

## Approach
1. Track which subagent tool_call_ids / subagent_ids are active per workflow phase while a portal-origin workflow runs.
2. On each WorkflowRunStateChangeEvent, pass stageSubagentIds (and stageToolCallIds if available) into projectWorkflowProgressForPortal.
3. Ensure ids match Portal SubagentRun.id (prefer tool_call_id used in tool_progress upsert keys).
4. Emit mid-run updates when subagents spawn/complete so stages refresh nest lists (not only phase transitions).
5. Unit tests: portal-progress with stage maps; gateway bridge integration test that projected stages include subagent_ids when subagents attached.

## Correlation strategy
- Prefer explicit workflow runtime attachment when spawn is owned by a phase/agent() call.
- If runtime lacks phase binding, attach concurrent subagents to the currently running phase as a pragmatic default (document in notes).
- Coordinate id format with packages/agent-core/src/subagents/portal-telemetry.ts.

## Files (lanyard-agent)
- apps/gateway/src/workflow-portal-progress.ts
- packages/workflow/src/portal-progress.ts
- packages/adapters-portal/src/wire/portal-metadata.ts (if needed)
- packages/workflow/test/portal-progress.test.ts
- gateway tests for bridge

## Repo
lanyard-agent primary. Platform bead lp-a8u.5 is client fallback.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Live workflow_progress stages include subagent_ids (or tool_call_ids) for phases that spawned subagents
- [ ] Ids match tool_progress subagent rows so Portal resolveStageSubagents returns non-empty
- [ ] Stage status transitions still correct (pending/running/done/failed)
- [ ] Unit tests cover stageSubagentIds projection and gateway emit payload shape
- [ ] With Portal UI (no client fallback required): expanded running stage shows nested chips instead of "No nested activity yet"
close_reason: Done. PR https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-agent/pull/221. stageSubagentIds on workflow_progress + mid-run emit.

title: new project: de-Hermes copy, short text, permissioned-root default path
description:
## Problem
New project dialog still references Hermes and has a long helper paragraph. Working directory defaults to ~/Name free-form instead of under the user's main permissioned working directory.

## Root cause
ChatHistorySideNav.tsx NewProjectDialog:
- subtitle: "Creates a Hermes project (agent working directory)"
- helper: Brain RPC + "local Hermes only for offline dev" + host path lecture
- defaultFolderPath → ~/${name}

## Approach
1. Subtitle: short product language only — e.g. "Creates a new project" (user asked: "should just say it creates a new project when you do this").
2. Remove or collapse helper to one short line max, or remove entirely if fields are self-explanatory.
3. Working directory default: under a permissioned root, not free ~/.
   - For this bead: introduce DEFAULT_PROJECTS_ROOT constant or env/BFF-provided root (e.g. from settings snapshot backend_home/projects, or pilot-known path).
   - defaultFolderPath(name) → `${permissionedRoot}/${slug}` not `~/${slug}`.
   - If product still shows the path field, keep it editable but prefilled under root; optional later: hide field and always create under root.
4. Vault empty-state "No Hermes projects" → "No agent projects" / "No projects" if still present (VaultView).
5. Do not rename hermesProjects.ts module in this bead (scope control). API path stays /api/agent/projects.

## Notes
Full multi-tenant ACL for "permissioned working directory" is later; this bead wires the default root assumption and copy.

## Files
- portal/packages/web/src/features/projects/ChatHistorySideNav.tsx
- portal/packages/web/src/features/projects/projectOptions.ts (hints)
- VaultView.tsx empty copy if still Hermes
- tests ChatHistorySideNav.test.tsx

## Repo
lanyard-platform (optional tiny BFF field for default root if needed)
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Dialog never shows the word Hermes

- [ ] Default working directory path is under a configured/permissioned root, not bare ~/Name (unless root itself is ~ for pilot)

title: document pane: inline reopen chip after close (OnlyOffice + preview)
description:
## Problem
When a document is shown in the sidebar pop-out (preview or OnlyOffice), closing the pane leaves no way to reopen it unless a citation chip already exists in the message. Soft-open / agent tool_target / path-in-message opens do not leave a durable inline control. User: "same inline chat button to click and open the sidebar again."

## Root cause
- artifactPanelReducer PANEL_CLOSE clears ref.
- handlePaneClose clears per-thread snapshot.
- Citation chips reopen via ChatMessageContent click; other open paths never mint a thread-local chip.

## Approach (chosen in plan)
Timeline document chip (citation-parity) on every successful document open:
1. When document pane opens for a vault path (any source), ensure a reopen affordance exists in the thread UI:
   - Prefer injecting/updating a lightweight "DocumentChip" on the timeline (or sticky near last assistant/user turn) with basename + path.
   - Click → openDocumentPathAction(path, source: "reopen_chip" | "citation") → SIDE_PANE_OPEN_DOCUMENT.
2. Chip remains after pane close; multi-doc: one chip per distinct path (latest N ok).
3. OnlyOffice: reopen to preview first (existing Edit flow); do not require session resume.
4. Reuse citation chip styling/handlers where possible (ChatMessageContent or shared DocumentChip).
5. Do not reopen Edit mode automatically.

## Non-goals
- Full edit-session resume after close
- Vault tab deep-link changes (already have Open in Vault)

## Files
- ChatView.tsx (open handlers, chip state)
- ChatTimeline / ChatMessageContent (chip render)
- documentPane/chatArtifactRouting.ts / artifactPanelReducer if needed for last-path retention
- tests: ChatView or DocumentPaneHost / new chip unit tests

## Repo
lanyard-platform only
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Open any vault document in chat pane (citation OR soft-open OR agent path) → close X → click inline document control → pane reopens same path
- [ ] OnlyOffice files reopen to preview; Edit still available when gates pass
- [ ] Multiple docs in one thread: each can be reopened via its chip
- [ ] No orphan chips for failed opens
- [ ] Unit tests for chip presence after open + reopen dispatch
- [ ] Live smoke on demo.localhost with .docx or similar
close_reason: Done. PR https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/194. Document reopen chip bar; unit tests pass.

title: subagent pop-out: markdown results + drop ID subtitle
description:

3. Change focusSubtitle for subagent to empty string, "Run detail", or better: resolve display name from roster in ChatView/ActivityPaneHost and pass as subtitle prop. Do not show raw id.
